Package gui

Class ReservationBoundry

java.lang.Object
gui.ReservationBoundry
public class ReservationBoundry extends Object
Boundary class for the Reservation screen. This class handles user interaction for creating new table reservations. It supports different user modes: logged-in Subscribers, Guests, and Representatives booking on behalf of customers.

      public void initData(data.Subscriber user, boolean custMod)

    • initData

      public void initData(data.Subscriber user, boolean custMod, boolean isEmbedded)
      Initializes the controller with user data and operation mode. Configures field visibility and editability based on whether the user is a Subscriber or a Guest/Representative.
      Parameters:
      user - The Subscriber object (can be null for Guests).
      custMod - true if the operator is a Representative booking for a customer.
      isEmbedded - true if the view is embedded in another screen (e.g., Dashboard).

      void checkAvailability(ActionEvent event)

      Parameters:
      event - The action event from the "Check Availability" button.

    • checkAvailabilityInternal

      private void checkAvailabilityInternal()
      Internal logic for checking table availability. Can be called from UI events or triggered by external updates.

    • updateAvailableHours

      public void updateAvailableHours(ArrayList<LocalTime> availableTimes)
      Callback method to update the UI with available time slots from the server. Filters out slots that are too close to the current time for same-day bookings.
      Parameters:
      availableTimes - List of LocalTime slots returned by the server.
